events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] International Arbitration Law+
events.outline: This course is organised by Paris Panthéon-Assas University, Singapore campus. This course covers the procedural framework and practical aspects of international arbitration and focusses on some common issues found in international arbitrations.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Mediating Card Fraud & Scams: The Applicable Law & Guidelines
events.outline: This programme seeks to set out the law relating to such scams, the applicable guidelines and the grey areas that could apply, including circumstances where the facts appear contradictory.

events.title: Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 1+
events.venue: SAL, Stamford 1 & 2, The Adelphi #08-08, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline:
Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 1 is an intensive two-day training programme conducted by SAL-SMC to learn the foundations of interest-based mediation which focuses on the disputing parties’ interests and encourages a broader range of solutions.

You will learn about the nature of conflicts and the most effective techniques to manage them. These fundamental dispute resolution strategies can be applied in diverse situations to manage work relationships within an organisation or with external parties, or to build stronger and more effective teams.

events.title: [WEBINAR] The 2026 Anti-Money Laundering Roadmap: Strengthening Firm Infrastructure and CDD Strategies
events.outline: This programme builds on Practice Direction 3.2.1 and offers practitioners a clear and practical roadmap to navigate the new requirements in 2026. Through a focused, practice-oriented approach, participants will learn how to build, implement and sustain a robust AML compliance framework that enhances organisational resilience and positions their firms to operate confidently within Singapore's evolving regulatory landscape.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Duties of Good Faith in Commercial Contracts
events.outline: This talk examines recent case law on good faith in contracts, including the effect of express good faith clauses, when courts may imply such terms, how they can be used to advance clients’ interests, and possible future developments in the law.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Peace in the Age of AI: From Principles to Practice
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. Artificial intelligence is reshaping global politics by intensifying competition, enabling information manipulation, and transforming conflict. It also offers peacebuilding opportunities through improved analysis, early warning, and inclusive dialogue. This webinar explores how to implement responsible AI in practice, ensuring trust, accountability, and human agency while addressing risks and supporting stability.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Enhancing Recovery for Creditors – A Discussion on Asset Tracing and Clawbacks
events.outline: This session explores efficient ways of asset tracing and highlights the potential issues which could arise during the process. The session also discusses developments in relation to clawbacks and its practical difficulties.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ACRA's Prescribed Anti-Money Laundering Combating the Financing of Terrorism ("AML/CFT") Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Chartered Secretaries Institute Singapore (CSIS). This course intends to equip [Registered Filing Agents (RFAs)] with the knowledge and understanding of anti-money laundering (AML) and counter financing of terrorism (CFT) to enable RFAs to comply with prevailing ACRA and relevant Singapore’s regulatory requirements.

events.title: STA Lunch Talk: Similar but Different – Offshore Centres Are Not the Same
events.venue: NTUC Business Centre, Room 701 One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline:
This event is organised by Singapore Trustees Association. Drawing on rare experience across offshore financial centres, Richard Grasby provides an update on legal, regulatory, and case law developments across key offshore centres—highlighting why a one-size-fits-all approach falls short. 
Richard Grasby is a Partner in Appleby’s Hong Kong office, leading the Private Client, Trusts and Family Office and Regulatory practice, advising on eight jurisdictions.

events.title: [CALS] Invisible Disabilities And The Law Conference
events.venue: Yale-NUS College Performance Hall NUS Law (UTown), Kent Ridge Campus
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This conference explores issues for lawyers, supporters, and caregivers of persons with Invisible Disabilities (“PWID”) in their encounters with the law. Sessions will cover the challenges that PWID face in the criminal justice system, and helping PWID learn and understand legal limits of their actions and behaviour. The conference will also provide comparative perspectives on PWID and the criminal justice system.

events.title: Realism and Ethics in International Relations
events.venue: YWCA Fort Canning Lodge - 6 Fort Canning Road, Level 2 (Sophia Cooke Ballroom), Singapore 179494
events.outline: This programme examines how realism and ethics shape international law and power politics. It explores recent global developments, the realist tradition’s view of law as state interest, and the risks of reducing law to spheres of influence. The session includes a lecture, Q&A, and networking dinner.

events.title: Cybersecurity Incident Response: Legal and Ethical Obligations for Law Firms
events.venue: Nordic Room (Level 3) 8 Wilkie Road, #03-08 Wilkie Edge  Singapore 228095
events.outline: This programme explores the legal, regulatory and ethical issues law firms face in managing cybersecurity risks and data breaches. It addresses notification duties, confidentiality, professional conduct and privilege, as well as high-pressure decisions involving ransom and stakeholder communications. Through case studies and practical guidance, participants will gain a clear framework for responding swiftly while meeting compliance and ethical obligations.

events.title: Advanced Certificate in Law and Technology Module 3: Applications of Data and AI in LegalTech+
events.outline: This module delves into Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Data in the legal industry. Participants will understand what is currently happening within this space and how AI and data can be utilised most efficiently within the legal sector.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Essential Written Advocacy Series 2026: Session 1 - General Principles of Effective Legal Writing
events.outline: This session will guide participants on the basic expectations of the recipient of a legal document, and correspondingly the general principles, including ethical principles to be applied in effective legal writing. This session forms the foundation upon which subsequent sessions will develop.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Differences in Division of Assets upon Divorce: Perspectives from International Family Lawyers on Working Together
events.venue: Webinar / Dentons Rodyk & Davidson LLP 80 Raffles Place #33-00 UOB Plaza 1 Singapore 048624
events.outline: This event is organised by Dentons Rodyk & Davidson LLP. Family law experts from Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, the US, and India will discuss diverse methods of dividing matrimonial assets, how different legal systems conceptualise asset division and the impact on cross-border disputes, criteria for divorce and asset division, forum selection challenges, and the roles of contributions and needs. The panel will also share practical strategies for lawyers managing global family disputes.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] M&A in Technology in the APAC Region+
events.outline: This course is organised by Paris Panthéon-Assas University, Singapore campus. This course covers legal tools to overcome challenges in the new era of M&A in technology in the Asia Pacific region.

events.title: Business Valuation for Litigators Module 3 – Income Approach
events.venue: Room 701, Level 7, NTUC Centre, One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organised by J.S. Held. Income approach is often preferred by valuers serving as expert witnesses in the context of disputes, since it enables the exact circumstances of the company being valued to be modelled. Due to the complexity of DCF models however, it also often leads to numerous areas of disagreement arising between opposing experts. This seminar looks at the income approach in detail, with a focus on the disagreements that often arise over how it should be applied and what inputs should be adopted.

events.title: ESG in Construction Law
events.venue: Room 901, Level 9 NTUC Centre, One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This seminar provides a practical construction law perspective on Environmental, Social, and Governance requirements in Singapore’s built environment sector and examines the deeper ecological context that should underpin ESG obligations. Our speakers will address the contractual allocation of ESG risks, regulatory compliance and emerging dispute issues to contribute to developing consistent industry approaches to ESG in construction law, including the evolution of standard clauses, risk allocation models and best practices.

events.title: JLP - Starting an Action+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #08-08, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Get equipped with essential and practical skills required to advise and assist clients dealing with the onset of a dispute.

events.title: SIArb Annual Debate 2026
events.venue: FTI Consulting, 1 Raffles Quay, #27-10, South Tower, Singapore 048583
events.outline: Following the success of last year’s event, the YPN returns this year with another hot topic for debate - "This House Believes that Experts are Overpaid Storytellers".

events.title: Injunctive Relief in Cross-Border Disputes: Recent  Themes and Issues
events.outline: This programme reviews recent developments in common law jurisdictions, particularly Singapore, concerning anti-suit injunctions (ASI) and anti-enforcement injunctions (AEI) in commercial, arbitration and trust disputes. Building on the SICC seminar in January 2026, speakers discuss the legal and strategic complexities of seeking or resisting ASIs and AEIs before Singapore courts, highlighting evolving judicial approaches, key practical challenges and important considerations for practitioners in cross-border litigation.

events.title: Corporate National Identity: What Lawyers Are Missing
events.venue: Function Lounge 4.02, Level 4, Singapore Management University, Yong Pung How School of Law,  55 Armenian Street, Singapore 179943
events.outline: Who determines a corporation's national identity? The standard legal tests, incorporation, real seat, corporate control, have long provided a working answer that is no longer sufficient. This lecture presents a framework showing that the legal facet alone produces material blind spots.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Sustainability Apex Programme Masterclass #9: Carbon Markets
events.outline: Introduction to carbon markets and their role in emissions reduction, covering compliance and voluntary carbon markets, emissions trading systems, and carbon taxation. Examination of carbon credits, project cycles, market dynamics, and the role of Renewable Energy Certificates within decarbonisation and sustainability frameworks.

events.title: 7th Lawtech Forum Asia
events.outline: Lawtech Summit positions itself as a working forum for the legal industry to tackle the "next chapter" issues: AI in production (not pilots), model governance and accountability, procurement and vendor risk, client expectations for transparency, and the new economics of legal services. It will also address the foundational enablers and constraints shaping adoption: cybersecurity and resilience, data compliance and cross-border data handling, and end-to-end digital transformation of law firms.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Essential Written Advocacy Series 2026: Session 2 - Key Considerations in Writing Legal Correspondence
events.outline: This session will examine the foundational considerations that underpin effective legal correspondence, founded on ethical practice. Participants will be guided on identifying the purpose and audience of a communication, structuring correspondence with clarity and precision, and striking the appropriate tone.

events.title: [WEBINAR] How might GenAI assist with business development for law firms
events.outline: This event is organised by A.B. Maximus & Co. Pte Ltd. When clients need a lawyer today, they don't just browse; they ask GenAI. To stay relevant, lawyers must understand the transformation from search engines to answer engines. How to ensure that legal articles or newsletter content get summarised inside an AI-generated recommendation in response to prospective clients’ web searches. The panellists will share their perspectives of the considerations to be deliberated in order to move from awareness to adoption of AI tools for implementation.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Modern Communications Law in Singapore: What Every Lawyer Needs to Know
events.outline: This webinar provides a practical and accessible primer on key developments in Singapore’s modern communications law. It introduces modern legislation: including Online Safety (Relief and Accountability) Bill and the Online Criminal Harms Act.

events.title: LawNet Training Workshop (26 May 2026)
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3 Room, The Adelphi, #07-01, 1 Coleman Street S179803
events.outline: This training workshop guides attendees through the new features and functionalities of LawNet.com. Through walkthroughs and hands-on exercises, participants will learn how to use the revamped platform efficiently.

events.title: JLP - Legal Innovation
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Understand legal innovation, map your organisation's tech footprint, and apply legal tech tools and generative AI in practice. Maintain ethical standards, optimize legal processes, and use legal design thinking to solve problems.

events.title: Certificate in Family Office & Governance
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This module introduces the family office landscape, core functions, and role within the private wealth ecosystem. It covers family governance structures, constitutions, councils, ownership and board dynamics, and alignment of values and roles. Participants also examine family dynamics, cultural influences, conflict management, and the legal professional’s role, supported by case studies and practical discussions.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Foundations of Dual Use in Space
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS-CIL . The discussion will focus on key themes, including the blurring of traditional legal categories, particularly between peaceful and non-peaceful uses of outer space under instruments such as the Outer Space Treaty. It will also examine how international humanitarian law applies in space, including targeting, proportionality, and the protection of civilian space infrastructure supporting military functions, as well as the growing role of commercial actors.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Employee Fraud - Asset Misappropriation
events.outline: Many fraudulent schemes are perpetrated by employees of the victim organisations. MDD has been engaged to assist in investigations relating to fraud and employee dishonesty matters. The presenter draws on her own experiences to explain the following (1) Accounting Fundamentals, (2) Asset Misappropriation, (3) Cash Receipts – Skimming & Larceny and (4) Fraudulent Disbursements.

events.title: JLP - Understanding Financial Statements+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Gain a practical, hands-on approach to understanding financial statements, tailored specifically to the needs of young corporate and litigation lawyers.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Essential Written Advocacy Series 2026: Session 3 - Starting Strong: Practical Tips in Pleading
events.outline: This session will guide participants on pleading facts without going into evidence, and structuring pleadings for precision and impact. The use of Generative AI in the preparation of pleadings will also be discussed, including the ethical limits of the use of Generative AI, and reliance on precedents.

events.title: Certificate in Wealth, Succession and Legacy
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This course provides an overview of the legal and practical considerations in wealth transition and succession planning. Participants examine how purpose and governance influence long-term family decisions, and review key estate-planning tools and structures. The module also explores philanthropic planning and the role of legal practitioners in supporting families through legacy, governance, and wealth-planning discussions.

events.title: Self-Leadership for Lawyers: Taking Charge of your Work Life (June 2026)+
events.venue: SAL, Stamford 1 & 2, The Adelphi #08-08, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: In the first session, participants will learn about purpose, values and strengths, the relevance of these in their legal work (and personal lives) and how using these can promote self-leadership and support a sustainable career in the legal profession.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (4 June)
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: Lexplorer Workshop Series 2: The Decisions You'll Make in Your First 5 Years (That will Shape the Next 20)
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: In collaboration with Iman Ibrahim (Over It Club), a former lawyer turned ICF-certified coach, SAL is proud to bring you this 3-hour guided interactive small-group workshop which introduces a practical framework to help young lawyers recognise these “invisible decisions,” understand how they compound over time, and how to make more calibrated choices about who they are becoming in the profession.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Essential Written Advocacy Series 2026: Session 4 - Pleading the Evidence: Affidavits
events.outline:
This session will guide participants on pleading facts without going into evidence, and structuring 
pleadings for precision and impact. The use of Generative AI in the preparation of pleadings will also 
be discussed, including the ethical limits of the use of Generative AI, and reliance on precedents.

events.title: Certificate in Multi-Jurisdictional Tax and Structures
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute (WMI). This module examines how family offices navigate cross-border tax and regulatory environments. It covers key regimes across major jurisdictions, with a focus on Singapore’s Section 13 incentives, licensing and structuring considerations. Participants explore CRS, FATCA, global minimum tax, and emerging trends, applying insights through practical case studies on family office operations.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Recent Highlights in Contract Law
events.outline:
Significant developments in Singapore contract law have taken place in the past year, including on issues concerning contract terms, vitiating factors, breach and remedies. 

This seminar will distil and highlight important recent developments and clarifications and, where useful, compare these with developments elsewhere.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Essential Written Advocacy 2026: Session 5 - Written Submissions that Win
events.outline: This session will provide guidance to participants on practical tools to produce clear, concise, and persuasive written submissions. The ethical and responsible use of Generative AI in drafting submissions will also be addressed, including issues of accuracy, confidentiality, and professional accountability.

events.title: Negotiating Success+
events.venue: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge Campus)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This 2-day workshop will focus on giving participants a working knowledge of the Interests-Based Model of Negotiation created by Roger Fisher and as taught at the Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School. It will be taught through a mixture of presentations, facilitated discussions and role plays.

events.title: [WEBINAR] E154: Anti-Money Laundering / Combating The Financing Of Terrorism (“AML / CFT”) Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA). The course is designed to enable RFAs to demonstrate knowledge and understanding of AML/CFT legislations, regulatory trends and developments in Singapore, knowledge and understanding of the AML/CFT environment in Singapore and international trends and typologies, knowledge and understanding of how to carry out risk assessment and conduct various types of customer due diligence, familiarity with ACRA Guidelines for RFAs and awareness of how ACRA’s Compliance review and inspections impact RFAs.

events.title: Mediation Advocacy+
events.venue: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge Campus)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: The field of mediation advocacy is about how one effectively represents oneself, or others at mediation. This workshop will focus on giving participants a working knowledge of how mediation works, the conflict resolution model used, preparing for mediation, dealing with the people aspect of disputes and strategies at the table. The workshop will also help participants understand the legal frameworks (both domestic and international) that apply to mediation.

events.title: Advanced Certificate in Law and Technology Module 4: Legal Innovation+
events.outline: In this module, participants will discover the tools and ideas that are driving these big changes. They will also study the principles of innovation and how tech disruption is affecting legal services; from understanding nuances to exploring how they are changing the way lawyers do their jobs.

events.title: Certificate for Family Office Advisors - Advanced+
events.venue: Wealth Management Institute, One Marina Boulevard, #16-01, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organised Wealth Management Institute Limited. by This advanced program goes beyond the basics of Family Offices, focusing on the psychology and motivations of today's UHNW families. It explores opportunities such as impact investing, where affluent clients can align their wealth decisions with societal and environmental values, offering insights into the emerging trends in the field.
